I had a disappointing experience at this clinic. While the staff was polite and courteous, the overall service was extremely slow and inefficient.

The doctor who attended us appeared very young and inexperienced. Despite clearly presenting symptoms of a sore throat, we were prescribed antihistamines too,
which did not seem appropriate for the condition. This raised concerns about the accuracy of the diagnosis and the quality of care provided.

What was most concerning, however, was the pricing. We were charged 2379 for tests that typically cost around 79, and 200 for Strepsils that usually cost 49. These charges feel excessive and unjustified.

Overall, despite the friendliness of the staff, the lack of efficiency, questionable medical judgment, and highly inflated prices made this a very poor experience. I would not recommend this clinic.

❌ The worst clinic I’ve ever dealt with Bodrum Clinic❌
My experience here was absolutely terrible and full of disrespect. I paid 6,300 baht, and they refused to give me the paper I needed for my insurance, even though I’ve been a regular client. When I asked to see the doctor, they said I had to pay again!
The receptionist in the blue uniform was extremely rude and unprofessional, with a terrible attitude that clearly showed she doesn’t care about patients at all.
This clinic has no sense of humanity all they care about is money. Their prices are overpriced, and they exploit sick people without any shame or empathy.
Avoid this place completely! There are much better and more honest clinics around.

Amazing service. Visit the clinic for a 2nd opinion after a getting scratched by a stray cat. (Not vaccinated for rabies)
Staff were extremely friendly and helpful, and helped me get my post exposure vacancies for rabies. Price was reasonable compared to the previous clinic I visited. Glad I went for a 2nd opinion 🙏😊

Would highly recommend for any travelers

It's very clear this place is designed to overcharge tourists. No compassion and very overpriced in comparison to other places.  You're lead to believe that they provide you one price which includes all in-clinic treatments for a couple of …

Apart from being very expensive, the nurses & doctor were amazing. Saw to me instantly & had me on an IV drip within 10 mins then advised I stayed in as a day patient so I could be monitored. Before anything is administered or done, a lady will come through to make sure you agree & their are no hidden payments, it was expensive but you can’t put a price on your health. I’m back in the UK and still recovering, but I’d recommend to come here if you have travel insurance & need a hygienic, well maintained doctors clinic whilst in Phuket. I think we paid just over £600 for 3 drips, day stay, monitoring & prescribed meds to take home.

The nurses are nice and their service is good but generally the whole process too slow.

text: I came in with strong stomach pain and vomiting, and I couldn’t have asked for better care. The staff was incredibly helpful and made sure I was well taken care of. The biggest pros are the short waiting time and professional treatment. If you have travel insurance, they’ll guide you through the process seamlessly. Highly recommend this clinic if you want to avoid stress during your holidays. Excellent service all around!

My husband and I arrived with symptoms of food poisoning and were promptly attended to. We were treated very well from the start by the staff, who were very kind. The facilities seem to be new and clean. We were already aware that they …

All of this was for ONE single IV drip. Nothing more.
The total bill was 18,800 THB.

To put this into perspective: in Thailand, many people work an entire month for 10,000 THB, yet this clinic charges almost double that amount for one IV.

They billed everything separately — doctor fee, nurse fee, observation room (not private), clinic service fee, and even basic disposable items like gloves, IV set, syringes, saline, alcohol pads. This is not healthcare, this is price exploitation.

There was no special treatment, no emergency, nothing advanced. Just a basic IV.
It’s very clear this place is designed to overcharge tourists who don’t know local prices.

Extremely disappointing and unethical.
Avoid this clinic if you are a tourist.
